content: Improper Words: As ironic style is hard for our model to learn, it may generate some improper words which make the sentence strange. As the example shown in the Table TABREF38 , the sentiment word in the input sentence is “wonderful" and the model should change it into a negative word such as “sad" to make the output sentence ironic. However, the model changes “friday" and “fifa" which are not related to ironic styles. We have not found a very effective method to address this issue and maybe we should further explore stronger models to learn ironic styles better.
